svg.title: Theo Hsiung
svg.desc: AI for Science, LLM systems and agentic infrastructure, over a night sky with a ringed planet and a moon. Three alternating scenes: an agent optimizing a liquid-cooling cold plate, pushing the Pareto frontier of thermal resistance and pressure drop; vLLM Semantic Router inside Claude Code sending each prompt to the right model, masking a secret, and holding a risky Bash command; and a concept of routing compute to orbit, where raw imagery is processed on an orbital node, heavy training goes to ground GPUs, and a task with no ground link waits for the next pass.
svg.text: AI for Science · LLM Systems · Agentic Infra
Associate Research Scientist, vLLM Semantic Router · Delta Electronics · Taiwan
